tagline: Premium, minimal reels: one cobalt title chip, one word at a time in a bold sans and an italic serif, list titles with photos floating above your head, or a moody montage of your own B-roll.
readiness_note: The list format needs only you talking. The montage format needs 25-40 of your own cinematic B-roll clips; with fewer than 12, reels are edited as lists.

captions: F-A list overlay: cobalt title chip at frame 0, one-word captions at the chest
F-A item ritual: italic-serif numbered title with a photo card floating above the head
F-B cinematic montage: own B-roll plate, one word in heavy grotesk then italic didone, ending on the 'KEYWORD' quote
